speaker: abel_garnish
text: Once more, Master Will, and the book is the same book. The column beside Costard is open. I have no figure to give you, and I will not borrow one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Borrow nothing. Tomorrow is the first time a yard hears it. Today is to see that we still have what we had yesterday.

speaker: will_kemp
text: What you had yesterday was a quiet messenger and a song, and a clown standing out of the light. Tomorrow the yard will want a reason it walked to Gracechurch Street. Remuneration is still a word you have underfed.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Say what is set down, Will. If tomorrow adds, the margin can take it then. Not this morning, and not as a kindness I owe you in advance.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Set down, set down. I am not asking you to love it. I am asking you to leave me the door. You may have your pause at the end. Give me the middle, where a man breathes.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou wilt have the end as thou marked it, Will, if I have anything to do with the last scene. I am not marrying them to please a Wednesday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave the refusal. The pause is the pause. Dick, if thou soften it I shall hear it from the tiring-house and I shall not thank thee.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I will not soften it. Berowne can ride a rhyme without a wedding at the end of it. Two of the clock tomorrow. I shall be ready, and I shall be long.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Sam has the note. He will lose the place once, and he will find the nail because we shamed him into it kindly. I am not teaching the song again this morning.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The gown is still on the hook, sir. The sleeves are still long. I know where Sam stands. I know to wait for the black before I answer.

speaker: john_sincler
text: Slower in. Then nothing. I have it, and I do not want a better death than the one you allowed me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then you have the whole of your part, Sincler. Do not improve it because the yard is empty.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Term ended on the twelfth. The Inns may come tomorrow all the same. I cannot enter a crowd that is not yet in the yard. I can enter two of the clock.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Enter two of the clock. If they come, they come. We do not play the comedy at them. We play it, and they may be in the way.

speaker: will_kemp
text: And if they laugh at what is not in your book, you will look at Abel, and Abel will look at me, and somebody will pretend the laugh was a mistake.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I will look at the margin. A laugh is not yet a line. When it is a line, I tick it. Until tomorrow there is nothing to tick.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou hearest him, Will. The man is obdurate, and he is right. Let the afternoon be The Shrew for those who are in it. Thou art not in it. Go home with the ending intact.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not in The Shrew. I know the bill. I will be at the lodging when it begins, and I will not send a note to the yard to prove it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Nick. Once, the answer, and late. Then we stop. Your voice is sound. I will not spend it on a third time through.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Dead for my life. After he has said his line, and not over it. Sir, is that the last of me today?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the last of thee today. Tomorrow thou art the Princess from the first entrance to the last, and the gown will be on thy back.

speaker: john_sincler
text: Then I am done being nothing until two of the clock tomorrow. It is a rest I can use.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Enjoy your rest, Sincler. Some of us are carrying a word that has not yet been paid its due. I will bring it tomorrow, Master Shakespeare, and I will look you in the face when I do.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Look me in the face, Will. Say the word that is written. We will see the rest when there is a yard, and not before.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Places for the oath, and then I shut the book. No total. Master Will, do not ask me again this morning. I have already said no in ink, by having written nothing.
